feature: Edit Original's Done stays readable behind another app
summary: In light mode, with the window behind another app, Edit Original's Done used to vanish from the title bar. It now shows as a grey Done. In front it is still the blue Done. Walk pictures now also say when they show the window behind another app.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Edit Original on a placed Button copy.

try.do: Switch the Mac to Light appearance, drop a Button from the Library and choose Edit Original.
Click another app's window so Photonz is behind it, and look at Done in the title bar.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Switch to Dark appearance with Photonz still behind and look at Done again.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click back into Photonz and check Done is the blue button again.

evaluate: With Photonz behind another app in light mode, can you read Done at a glance?
Does the grey Done look like the rest of a Mac window that is behind another app, or does it look wrong?
In front, is Done exactly the blue button you had before?
Does the line under a walk picture, saying it shows the window behind another app, stop you judging those pictures as the window in front?
rough: No mock draws the Edit Original title bar, so there is nothing to put it beside.

Adjust Grid's Done, Crop, Trim and the other blue buttons still go white on white in light mode behind another app; that is blue-done-crop-and-trim-buttons-stay-readable-wi, with a picture of Adjust Grid's bar (2026-10-09-adjust-grid-done-behind-light-sc.png).
A walk still cannot photograph the in-front look without taking the Mac to itself ("front": true). Pictures are labelled instead, not changed.
